data.name: Chaos Cinema
data.detailed_description:
Chaos Cinema

Take over a run-down cinema and bring it back to life step by step.

Welcome to Chaos Cinema, a first-person cinema management game where you take over an old, neglected movie theater and try to turn it into a successful business again.

At the beginning, your cinema is dirty, damaged and only partially operational. Clean it up, remove old and broken elements, restock your stations and prepare everything for your first customers.

Sell tickets, purchase movie licenses and schedule your screenings. Run the concession counter, fill drinks, prepare popcorn and nachos, add flavors and extras, and assemble the correct orders for your customers.

But daily operations do not always go according to plan.

Drinks can spill, popcorn ends up on the floor, customers lose their patience and supplies run out exactly when the lobby is full. Machines and stations need to be refilled, trash needs to be removed, counters need to be cleaned and bathrooms need to be kept in order.

Your guests react to waiting time, accuracy, cleanliness, movies and ambience. Their ratings become visible during their visit and influence how successful your cinema becomes in the long run.

Every day is a balancing act between service, time pressure, cleanliness, supplies, movie scheduling and money. Earn enough to order new stock, improve your cinema and gradually turn a run-down building into a well-running movie theater.

Features

First-Person Cinema Management
Work directly inside your cinema. Sell tickets, run the concession counter, clean up, restock supplies and handle the daily operation yourself.

Hands-On Snack Service
Grab cups and containers directly from your stations, fill drinks, prepare popcorn and nachos, and assemble complete customer orders on the counter.

Flavors and Extras
Orders can include different sizes, flavors and add-ons. Pay close attention to exactly what your customers ordered.

Tickets and Movie Scheduling
Sell tickets, purchase movie licenses and plan when your movies will play in your auditorium.

Customers With Visible Reactions
Customers react to waiting times, incorrect orders, cleanliness, movies and service. Their ratings become visible during their visit.

Countdown to Showtime
Your guests want tickets and snacks, but the movie will not wait. Serve them in time before the screening begins.

Stock and Supply Management
Order supplies for your stations and storage area. Cups, popcorn, sauces, candy, drinks and other consumables need regular restocking.

Cleaning and Chaos System
Spilled drinks, popcorn on the floor, trash, dirty counters and messy bathrooms are all part of the job. Different types of mess require different cleaning methods.

Renovate Your Cinema
Your cinema starts in rough shape. Remove old and broken elements, clean everything up and improve the building step by step.

Ratings and End-of-Day Results
Speed, accuracy, cleanliness, movies and ambience influence your guests' opinions and the overall rating of your cinema.

Stylized Low-Poly Look
A colorful and playful visual style creates a charming and easy-to-read atmosphere.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6 GB / RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requirements may change during development. SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended.
